name: parity
description: A small set that reaches every request kind of Dreaming: gate (keep and skip), sentence, rewrite, relation, the LLM relation tie-break and merge. It also has text that JSON must escape (quotes, '<', non-ASCII). Use it with run_eval.py --proxy, then parity_check.py. The relevance question runs only at chat time, so this set does not reach it.

turns.user: I have a cat named Miso. What is a good scratching post?
turns.assistant: A tall sisal post that does not wobble.

turns.user: I play the guitar. Can you recommend a beginner song list?
turns.assistant: Try Wonderwall and Horse with No Name.

turns.user: Can you explain how a heat pump works?
turns.assistant: It moves heat from outside to inside with a refrigerant cycle.

turns.assistant: Use a callout with a minus sign.
